items.event_time_ist: Poll published Oct 13, 2026; annual Governance poll conducted Sept 1-17, 2026
items.summary: Gallup's annual Governance poll finds the Democratic Party viewed favorably by 43% of Americans vs 35% for Republicans — an 8-point gap, above the 5-point long-run average. Democrats lead 44-33 on handling the nation's most important problem (a reversal from GOP +11 in 2022) and 51-37 on keeping the country prosperous, their largest edge since 2007. On protecting the U.S. from foreign threats, Democrats lead 46-42 — only the third time since 2002 the GOP has not led there. 59% call GOP views 'too extreme' vs 43% for Democrats. Independents drive the shift: 40% view Dems favorably vs 27% GOP; 50% of independents say Dems would keep the country prosperous vs 32% GOP. Gallup notes a majority still views the Democratic Party unfavorably overall.
items.title: Gallup: Democrats now hold the advantage on party image and the economy
